meaning: Include me on updates or the email thread.
example: Manager: "Loop me in when Accounts replies."

meaning: Send a quick message when something happens.
example: "Ping me on Slack when the patient confirms."

meaning: I'm aware and will follow up.
example: "That ticket is on my radar — I'll update you by EOD Central."

meaning: End of day (confirm timezone — usually US team local time).
For your information — no action required unless noted.
example: Subject: FYI — clinic closed Monday for holiday.

meaning: Mark as important or escalate for attention.
example: "Please flag this if the pharmacy still hasn't received it in 24 hours."

meaning: I don't have capacity right now (polite no or defer).
example: "I don't have bandwidth this hour — can we touch base at 2 PM CT?"

meaning: A short meeting or call to align.
example: "Can we do a 5-minute quick sync on the refill queue?"
"I'll reach out to the patient to confirm the pharmacy."

meaning: Check back later on an open item.
example: "I'll follow up tomorrow if we don't hear from billing."

meaning: Politely disagree or ask for more time / clarity.
example: "I may need to push back on that deadline — here's what's open on my list."

meaning: The plan for how we'll handle something.
example: "What's our game plan if prior auth is denied?"

meaning: Everything is complete — nothing else needed from them.
example: After scheduling: "You're all set for Tuesday at 10 AM Central."
